verdict: Yes, if you work with artisans as partners. Pabiben, founded by an artisan from Kutch, pitched handcrafted products sold directly by artisans on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Buyers pay more when they know who made a piece and that the artisan was paid fairly.
angle: Most artisans sell through middlemen who keep a large share of the price. An artisan-direct brand shares more with makers and tells their stories. Corporate gifting, exhibitions and export buyers value this model.
